author: Clijmart
body:
So... Yeah... I'm looking for a team it looks like :D

Info:
I'm a rusher, love to sneak around, trying to break that god damn monument or steal the wools :3
If I'm bored, I build rollercoasters/houses.

My KD may be a bit low, since I don't care about killing players, but mostly about winning the game.

Timezone:
GMT+1

Contacts:
Skype - Clijmart
TeamSpeak
Discord if needed, not a huge fan of it tho...

Team Experience:
Xenarch for a short amount of time.
NecroMancy for a longer time :P

Interests:
I love DTM, but CTW and CTF are great too, in my opinion.
